description: Comparison graphic stacking two U.S. maps. The top map (with legend) colors states brown that offer driving privileges to unauthorized immigrants (including Washington, California, Nevada, Utah, Colorado, New Mexico, Illinois, Vermont, Maryland, Connecticut, Delaware, Hawaii and DC) and green those that do not. The bottom map is a 270toWin-style 2016 presidential electoral map showing states in red or blue with electoral vote counts. Per the filename, the pairing implies a claimed correlation between states licensing unauthorized immigrants and states voting Democratic; the graphic itself asserts no explicit conclusion.
